scope: Local source, isolated PostgreSQL and temporary containers; no production deployment
limitations: No production data or MinIO objects changed
TLS/DNS/firewall/backup restoration must be accepted by IT on staging
Dependency audit is not a penetration test
Media report is local HTTP fallback measurement, not live production browser network
Rate limit storage is per process; replicas require shared storage
deployment: CI checks/builds only; IT deploys root Compose
legacy: deploy/legacy retains previous deployment/rollback tools; restore paths are in paths.json
